decisions.reason: Active development with multiple releases and a dedicated page indicates strong commitment and low withdrawal risk.
Limited visibility and similarity to the discontinued search extension raise risk, but it remains a useful plugin likely retained.
Home-page placement and mobile optimization align with strategic priorities, keeping withdrawal risk low.
As the flagship platform and central product line, it is highly unlikely to be dropped.
Dedicated page and alignment with mobile field workflows support retention, with only moderate competitive risk.
